# Japanese Mahjong Font with OpenType

> A web playground and font for rendering Japanese (Riichi) Mahjong tile
> diagrams. Tiles are written as a short notation string (e.g. `123m456p11z`)
> and rendered as scalable color or monochrome SVG. The site also exposes an
> Image API that turns any notation string into an embeddable SVG image,
> shields.io-style.

Site: https://mahjongfont.pages.dev
Source: https://github.com/rutopio/Japanese-Mahjong-Font-with-OpenType
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1

## Tile notation

A tile string is a concatenation of tile tokens with no separators.

- Man (manzu): `1m`–`9m`
- Pin (pinzu): `1p`–`9p`
- Sou (souzu): `1s`–`9s`
- Zi (honor tiles): `1z`–`9z`. Order is winds then dragons:
  `1z` East, `2z` South, `3z` West, `4z` North, `5z` White, `6z` Green, `7z` Red.
- Dice: `1.`–`6.`
- Red five (aka-dora): append `*`, e.g. `5m*`, `5p*`, `5s*`.
- Called meld / open tile (fuuro): append `-`, e.g. `3m3m3m-` (pon),
  `4s5s-6s` (chi), `6m6m6m-6m` (daiminkan).
- Added kan (ka-kan): append `=`, e.g. `3m3m3m-3m=`.
- Closed kan (an-kan): use `0m`, `0p`, `0s`, `0z` for the face-down tiles.
- Gap / spacing: `_` inserts a gap, e.g. `123m456p_5z`.

Example string: `7m7m7m2p3p4p8p8p8p4s5s6s8s_8s`

## Image API

Put a tile notation string in the URL path to get an inline SVG image you can
embed anywhere (Markdown, HTML, GitHub READMEs, chat). The response is a vector
SVG, so it can be resized freely. Output is a pure function of the URL and is
cached aggressively at the edge.

### Endpoint

```
GET https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/img/<tile>?theme=<color|mono>&color=<hex>
```

Returns: `Content-Type: image/svg+xml`. Rendered at a fixed height of 500px;
width scales proportionally. Returns HTTP 400 with `No tiles to render` when
the tile string produces no tiles.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Location | Type             | Default  | Notes                                                        |
| --------- | -------- | ---------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `tile`    | path     | string           | required | Tile notation string (see above). Use `_` for a gap.         |
| `theme`   | query    | `color` \| `mono`| `color`  | `color` for colorful tiles, `mono` for monochrome.           |
| `color`   | query    | string (hex)     | `AA7942` | Main tile color, six-digit hex without `#`. Only when `theme=color`. |

Omitted parameters fall back to their defaults.

### Examples

- Default colors:
  `https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/img/7m7m7m2p3p4p8p8p8p4s5s6s8s_8s`
- Custom color (green):
  `https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/img/1m2m3m4p5p6p7s8s9s?theme=color&color=2D7D46`
- Monochrome:
  `https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/img/1z2z3z4z5z6z7z?theme=mono`

### Embedding

Markdown:

```md
![](https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/img/7m7m7m2p3p4p8p8p8p4s5s6s8s_8s)
```

HTML:

```html
<img src="https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/img/7m7m7m2p3p4p8p8p8p4s5s6s8s_8s" />
```

### Tip

Any share URL from the playground can be turned into an image by swapping the
`?tile=` query for the `/img/` path:

```
https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/?tile=123m456p_5z&theme=color&color=AA7942
https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/img/123m456p_5z?theme=color&color=AA7942
```

## Pages

- [Playground](https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/): Interactive tile editor.
- [Image API docs](https://mahjongfont.pages.dev/img): Live examples and the parameter reference.
- [Font releases](https://github.com/rutopio/Japanese-Mahjong-Font-with-OpenType/releases): Download the OpenType/woff2 fonts.
